hyperparameter_tuning.tuning_explanation: In Phase 11, sequential evaluation used a shared user manager across policies, altering the sequence of user histories and user interactions across sweeps, whereas in Phase 11B/12A each evaluation runs in strict environment isolation under common random numbers. Tuning across isolated runs on seeds 101-105 selected alpha* = 0.5 (lower cumulative regret than 0.25) and gamma* = 0.9995 (faster adaptation to abrupt drift than 0.9999).

calibration_per_difficulty.jensen_convexity_note: On negative logits (beta_click = 5.72), the sigmoid function is convex. By Jensen's inequality, E[sigmoid(X + epsilon)] > sigmoid(E[X]), so higher noise sigma=0.80 elevates random click probability to ~6.97% compared to ~5.23% at sigma=0.15.
